card.name: Last word before a warning's end
card.fires_on: The final word of a short warning or restriction in instructions, such as 'only', 'backed up', 'snap off' or 'intravenously', just before the sentence ends or a caution is completed.

modes.label: End of a restriction
modes.description: The last word of a limiting phrase in a usage note, right before the closing bracket or period.

modes.label: Do-not instruction
modes.description: The final word of a 'do not' handling instruction in device or administration steps.
modes.example: Twist off (do not snap<< off>>) the syringe cap

modes.label: Partway through a long word in a caution
modes.description: The middle or end of a long adverb or adjective inside a caution.
modes.example: Do not inject subcutaneously or intraven<<ously>>.

card.writes: It promotes exclamation marks, so it pushes the text toward ending the warning with '!'.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of a caution or 'do not' note, where an exclamation mark could come next.
